verdict.rationale: Text extracted from the main uspto.gov guidance pages (trademarks/apply, patents, fees-and-payment, application-timeline) shows that public reading surface was retrievable, and the 404s for llms.txt and .md paths came back as normal server responses rather than a bot wall or CAPTCHA. However, the developer portal serves a JavaScript-only app shell to a keyless fetch, so part of the published documentation is not readable by a plain agent. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on probe confirming HTTP 200 with readable HTML on the guidance pages under an identified agent user agent; developer documentation readable without JS execution.
